text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Vodka. Just you wait, 
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The one taking the Oka Sho... will be 
Aston Machan."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...'The one who will take it is Aston 
Machan'...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I see. ...Maybe I underestimated 
you, Chan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Her speed and power are proven; she's 
clearly talented among her generation."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, it didn't feel like we were rivals. 
Probably because... I thought Machan 
wasn't interested in me at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because I never thought you'd ever 
consider competing with me for anything.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why not, Chan? I'll take you on...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Kh, haah, haah, haah! This is brutal... 
but!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Not enough, not enough, not enough! Still 
nowhere near enough!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just when things are getting fun. I'm 
gonna snatch it away and blow you all out 
of the water...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: One more rep! Doryaaaaaaahh--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's challenge caused quite a 
stir, especially shocking the two rivals 
it was thrown down to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've sent it, I can't afford to 
show anything pathetic. Fired up with 
determination, she headed off to training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, it is just that spring and I are not 
on good terms. I can still train.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't quite get it, but better safe 
than sorry. I decided to take her to the 
infirmary just in case."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it's not a cold. Doesn't seem 
like hay fever either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, just as she said, we couldn't 
find anything particularly wrong.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...That is why... Simply, with spring...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
She might have built up a lot of fatigue. 
Let's let her sleep a bit longer before 
heading home.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Nothing seems to be wrong, but... to be 
safe, let's take today off from training. 
Please ease back into it tomorrow while 
monitoring the situation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the cause of the slight 
illness remained unknown—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And days like that continued for a while.
choice_data_list:
...I really want to know the cause, to be 
honest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she claims to "not get along with 
spring," she must have something specific 
in mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to ask her a bit more 
about it directly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...When spring comes, Machan gets like 
this."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I feel drowsy, restless, and just a little 
under the weather.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I went to my mother's clinic for a 
detailed checkup and tried various 
medicines and herbal remedies, but we 
still couldn't really figure it out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, in other words, they must not be on 
good terms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's mother is a doctor. Which 
means she probably truly doesn't know the 
cause.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I'll perk right up once summer 
comes around.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you're right. I can't go into the 
Oka Sho like this...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's play our trump card.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she casually walked out of 
the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She returned, clutching her bento box.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The 'Making Friends with Spring' gathering 
is now in session.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Horsetails, canola blossoms, and dango. I 
packed all the little signs of spring I 
spotted into this bento box.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll line these up... and try 
complimenting them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea whatsoever if that would 
actually solve anything, but—
choice_data_list: (No, it might still work as a placebo)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, it's quite possible 
that her current poor condition is due to 
her being overly worked up for the Oka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hoping it would bring some peace of mind, 
I decided to take them up on the offer."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful—this color, this shape. When 
one thinks of spring flowers, it's you, 
Mr. Sparkling Canola Flower.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And as for you, lovely to look at, 
delicious to eat, and kneading you brings 
so much happiness."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Sanshoku Mochimochi Taro. 
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And here, lined up so endearingly along 
the riverbank and looking right this way, 
is an utterly lovely sight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Tsuku-Tsuku-Tsukucchi-san. 
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in that manner, our "Befriending 
Spring Gathering" continued until the sun 
went down—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I suppose that should do it. I 
feel like we've gotten quite a bit closer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, starting tomorrow, everything will 
surely be alri—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Did you hear the sound of waves?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Your face says you're sure you did, but... 
thinking back, I don't recall hearing any 
sound like that in particular.
choice_data_list:
Maybe it just picked up sound from a TV 
somewhere?

Maybe it just picked up a TV somewhere, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume have sharp hearing. Perhaps she 
caught a sound playing from a distance too 
far for humans to perceive.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? I can hear the TV. But 
still—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No, that's true... ...Maybe you're right.
